description: Suggest a few gift ideas for a budget, optional interests, and language, plus the site's own shops when one fits. Ideas are suggestions, not a catalog. Read-only. No draw and no personal data.

currency.description: ISO currency code. Defaults from the region.

interests.description: Optional interests used to pick ideas, such as cooking or books.

language.description: Language of the reply and the share messages: en, es, ca, de, pt, fr, it, nl, pl, da, no, sv, ru, ko, ja. Defaults from region.

region.description: Region code from list_regions (US, ES, CT for Catalonia, DE, MX, …). Sets the local name of the game, the default language and the currency.

name: gift_ideas
title: Gift ideas
